summary.headline: Cheap Chinese models take a third of US enterprise tokens
summary.body: A mixed, slightly brighter day. CNBC reported that cheap Chinese open models have held over 30% of weekly OpenRouter token traffic since February, peaking at 46%. More choice and lower prices spread AI power around, easing Power Concentration, which helps Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia and trims Enslaved God. The UN's AI for Good summit opened in Geneva with a new commission on sharing AI gains with poorer nations. Anthropic signed a $19 billion data-center lease with TeraWulf, adding capability. On the darker side, Meta's new image generator drew privacy criticism for drawing on others' public Instagram photos, lifting 1984, and a Maryland county extended its data-center pause after protests. Horizon Balance: +0.87.
summary.movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.1, Egalitarian Utopia +0.1 and Gatekeeper +0.1. The CNBC token-share report drove the utopias (Libertarian Utopia +0.14), Meta Muse added 1984 +0.13, and the UN summit lifted Gatekeeper.
coming_up: UN AI for Good Global Summit runs July 7-10 in Geneva

events.title: Anthropic signs $19B data-center lease with TeraWulf
events.summary: Anthropic signed a long-term lease with nuclear- and hydro-powered operator TeraWulf, adding to over 1 GW of US capacity ahead of its planned IPO.

events.title: CNBC: Chinese models now handle 30-46% of US enterprise gateway tokens
events.summary: CNBC reported cheap Chinese open models have held over 30% of weekly OpenRouter token traffic since February, peaking at 46%, as firms like Lindy switch from US models to cut costs.
events.reason: Open Chinese models eroding US lab dominance in usage.

events.title: UN AI for Good Global Summit opens in Geneva; new Global Commission launched
events.summary: The ITU's AI for Good summit ran July 7-10 in Geneva; the UN and ITU also launched an AI for Good Global Commission co-chaired by Marc Benioff and Paul Kagame on sharing AI gains with developing nations.

events.title: Prince George's County extends pause on hyperscale data centers after protests
events.summary: Following a July 1 rally demanding a ban, Maryland's Prince George's County Council approved a two-year moratorium on new hyperscale data-center development.
events.reason: Local moratorium driven by protests. Vote date inferred from Jul 8 reports.

events.title: Meta's Muse image generator criticised for using others' public Instagram photos
events.summary: Meta launched its first in-house image model across its apps, drawing privacy criticism over a feature that can draw on other users' public Instagram photos.
events.reason: Platform-scale use of personal images; minor.
